why: Exact independent abstract counterexample: Var=n^(2/3)+n^(3/4)/log n gives exponent 3/8, while the Bernoulli perturbation vanishes in probability and |Q_n-EQ_n|/s_n<2.1. Fourth standardized moment grows like n^(1/4).
